arxiv-2104-12883.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Tyler Nelson, Yuan-Sen Ting, Keith Hawkins, Alexander Ji, Harshil Kamdar, Kareem El-Badry. Comoving pairs, even at the separations of 𝒪 ⁡ ( 10 6 ) \mathcal{O}(10^{6})\, AU, are a predicted reservoir of conatal stars. We present detailed chemical abundances of 62 stars in 31 comoving pairs with separations of 10 2 − 10 7 10^{2}-10^{7}\, AU and 3D velocity differences < 2 ​ km ​ s − 1 <2\mathrm{\ km\ s^{-1}} . This sample includes both bound comoving pairs/wide binaries and unbound comoving pairs.

arxiv-2108-00394.title: Deep graph matching meets mixed-integer linear programming: Relax at your own risk ?
arxiv-2108-00394.creator: Zhoubo Xu, Puqing Chen, Romain Raveaux, Xin Yang, Huadong Liu
arxiv-2108-00394.description: Abstract Graph matching is an important problem that has received widespread attention, especially in the field of computer vision. Recently, state-of-the-art methods seek to incorporate graph matching with deep learning. However, there is no research to explain what role the graph matching algorithm plays in the model.

arxiv-2112-02898.title: CaCu 3 Ru 4 O 12 : a high Kondo-temperature transition metal oxide
arxiv-2112-02898.creator: D. Takegami, C. Y. Kuo, K. Kasebayashi, J.-G. Kim, C. F. Chang, C. E. Liu, C. N. Wu, D. Kasinathan, S. G. Altendorf, K. Hoefer, F. Meneghin, A. Marino, Y. F. Liao, K. D. Tsuei, C. T. Chen, K.-T. Ko, A. Günther, S. G. Ebbinghaus, J. W. Seo, D. H. Lee, G. Ryu, A. C. Komarek, S. Sugano, Y. Shimakawa, A
arxiv-2112-02898.description: Abstract We present a comprehensive study of CaCu 3 Ru 4 O 12 using bulk sensitive hard and soft x-ray spectroscopy combined with local-density approximation (LDA) + dynamical mean-field theory (DMFT) calculations. Correlation effects on both the Cu and Ru ions can be observed.

arxiv-2201-11628.title: Early Detection of Network Attacks Using Deep Learning Thanks: Pre-print submitted to ITEQS 2022
arxiv-2201-11628.creator: Tanwir Ahmad 1 , Dragos Truscan 1 , Jüri Vain 1 2 , and Ivan Porres 1
arxiv-2201-11628.description: Abstract The Internet has become a prime subject to security attacks and intrusions by attackers. These attacks can lead to system malfunction, network breakdown, data corruption or theft. A network intrusion detection system (IDS) is a tool used for identifying unauthorized and malicious behavior by observing the network traffic.

arxiv-2210-01076.title: qTask: Task-parallel Quantum Circuit Simulation with Incrementality
arxiv-2210-01076.creator: Tsung-Wei Huang
arxiv-2210-01076.description: Abstract Incremental quantum circuit simulation has emerged as an important tool for simulation-driven quantum applications, such as circuit synthesis, verification, and analysis. When a small portion of the circuit is modified, the simulator must incrementally update state amplitudes for reasonable turnaround time and productivity. However, this type of incrementality has been largely ignored by existing research.

arxiv-2211-08845.creator: Aakriti Sharma, Ajay K. Sharma
arxiv-2211-08845.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Aakriti Sharma, Ajay K. Sharma. In this paper, we characterize bounded, compact and order bounded sum of weighted differentiation composition operators from Bergman type spaces to weighted Banach spaces of analytic functions, where the sum of weighted differentiation composition operators is defined as S u → , τ n ​ ( f ) = ∑ j = 0 n D u j , τ j ​ ( f ) , f ∈ ℋ ⁡ ( 𝔻 ) . arxiv-2305-18918.title: Proximity effect of time-reversal symmetry broken non-centrosymmetric superconductors.
arxiv-2305-18918.creator: Tim Kokkeler, Alexander Golubov, Sebastian Bergeret, Yukio Tanaka
arxiv-2305-18918.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Tim Kokkeler, Alexander Golubov, Sebastian Bergeret, Yukio Tanaka. In non-centrosymmetric superconductors the pair potential has both even-parity singlet and odd-parity triplet components. If time-reversal symmetry is broken, the superconducting phase of these components is not the same, for example in anapole superconductors. In this paper it is shown that breaking time-reversal symmetry by a phase difference between the two components significantly alters both the density of states and the conductance in s+helical p-wave superconductors.

arxiv-2308-09207.title: Average partial effect estimation using double machine learning
arxiv-2308-09207.creator: Harvey Klyne, Rajen D. Shah
arxiv-2308-09207.description: Abstract Single-parameter summaries of variable effects are desirable for ease of interpretation, but linear models, which would deliver these, may fit poorly to the data. A modern approach is to estimate the average partial effect—the average slope of the regression function with respect to the predictor of interest—using a doubly robust semiparametric procedure.

arxiv-2401-13215.title: ν \nu Oscillation : a software package for computation and simulation of neutrino propagation and interaction
arxiv-2401-13215.creator: Seonghyeok Jang, Eunil Won, Kyungmin Lee, Eunju Jeon, Young Ju Ko
arxiv-2401-13215.description: Abstract The behavior of neutrinos is the only phenomenon that cannot be explained by the standard model of particle physics. Because of these mysterious neutrino interactions observed in nature, at present, there is growing interest in this field and ongoing or planned neutrino experiments are seeking solutions to this mystery very actively.

pmc-10568686.title: Cracking Behavior and Stress Field Evolution in Coal Specimens Containing Bedding under Uniaxial Compression
pmc-10568686.creator: Chang Guo, Zedong Wang, Ting Liu, Baiquan Lin, Chuanjie Zhu, Zhanbo Huang, Nan Liu
pmc-10568686.description: During the underground mining process, various coal seams with different bedding structures are often encountered. The presence of bedding structures is one of the primary factors that influence the strength and deformation characteristics of the coal seam and then affect gas extraction and gas disaster prevention.

pmc-11382111.title: Protein is expressed in all major organs after intravenous infusion of mRNA-lipid nanoparticles in swine
pmc-11382111.creator: Francesca Ferraresso, Katherine Badior, Monica Seadler, Youjie Zhang, Amanda Wietrzny, Massimo F Cau, Amber Haugen, Geoffrey G Rodriguez, Mitchell R Dyer, Pieter R Cullis, Eric Jan, Christian J Kastrup
pmc-11382111.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). In vivo delivery of mRNA is promising for the study of gene expression and the treatment of diseases. Lipid nanoparticles (LNPs) enable efficient delivery of mRNA constructs, but protein expression has been assumed to be limited to the liver.

pmc-11550675.title: Exploring the protective effect of silver Croton tiglium nano-extract against azoxymethane induced toxicity in female reproductive organs in rats
pmc-11550675.creator: Wael Mahmoud Aboulthana, Abd El-Nasser A Madboli, Amal Gouda Hussien, Mohamed Seif
pmc-11550675.description: Reproductive toxicity from food and environmental contaminants has greatly affected human life. Plants are a fundamental source of bioactive components for relieving the harmful effects of pollutants. Hydrazine metabolites pose health threats when they enter the food chain. Croton tiglium (C. tiglium) exhibits anti-inflammatory and anti-tumor properties. Silver nanoparticles enhance the chemical stability of C. tiglium.

pmc-12595073.title: When extubation turns fatal: Delayed hemoptysis from negative pressure pulmonary hemorrhage
pmc-12595073.creator: Mohammed AbuBaha, Hossam Salameh, Wael Hashem, Hasan Khalili, Bara Abubaha, Mohammad Bdair, Hatem M. Taha
pmc-12595073.description: Negative pressure pulmonary hemorrhage (NPPH) is a rare but serious complication following upper airway obstruction, often due to forceful inspiratory efforts.We report a case of a 25-year-old diabetic male who developed sudden hemoptysis and dyspnea after routine varicocelectomy. The patient had likely bitten the endotracheal tube during extubation, causing transient airway obstruction.

pmc-12618930.title: Electrodeposition of magnetic nanonetworks featuring triangular motifs and parallel ridges on a macroscopic scale
pmc-12618930.creator: Fei Chen, Junkang Shan, Xi Wang, Jingning Li, Fei Jia, Fan Wang, Zihao Yang, Kai Liu, Ru-Wen Peng, Mu Wang
pmc-12618930.description: Ordered nanostructured magnetic networks offer a versatile platform for studying magnetic frustration, reconfigurable magnonics, and neuromorphic computing. Their fabrication, however, often relies on complicated and expensive nanolithography. Here, we demonstrate an electrochemical strategy for growing large-area magnetic networks composed of self-organized triangular motifs separated by periodic parallel ridges.

pmc-12621466.title: Duodenocolic fistula after laparoscopic ileocecal resection for ascending colon cancer: A case report
pmc-12621466.creator: Noriyuki Sasaki, Shingo Mitomo, Yusuke Matsui, Yugo Ishii, Akira Sasaki
pmc-12621466.description: IntroductionDuodenoileal and duodenocolic fistulas are rare complications often associated with inflammatory bowel disease, cancer, or peptic ulcers. Fistulas that form between the duodenum and a gastrointestinal anastomosis site following colorectal cancer surgery are extremely rare. Here, we report a rare case of duodenocolic fistula following laparoscopic ileocecal resection for ascending colon cancer.

pmc-12641705.title: Optimizing Permanganic Acid Production: Effects of Temperature on Stability
pmc-12641705.creator: Abdel Elfatah Bakhite Adam, Tomo Suzuki-Muresan, Aditya Rivonkar, Marcel Mokili, Victoria Samanidou
pmc-12641705.description: In the nuclear industry, the decontamination of nuclear metallic structures is an essential process to reduce radiation exposure during maintenance or dismantling. The oxide layer, such as chromium (III) oxide (Cr2O3), formed on stainless steel and nickel-based alloys, contributes significantly to surface radioactivity by trapping radioactive contaminants.

pmc-12664018.title: Changes in Cardiovascular Risk Factors in U.S. Adults Before and After the COVID-19 Pandemic
pmc-12664018.creator: Huanhuan Yang, Chenxi Huang, Mitsuaki Sawano, Jeph Herrin, Kamil F. Faridi, Mohammed Essa, Devesh Malik, Zhihui Li, Harlan M. Krumholz, Yuan Lu
pmc-12664018.description: nal physical activity increased and vigorous activity decreased after the pandemic, suggesting beneficial lifestyle adaptation. What is the clinical question being addressed? Did traditional cardiovascular risk factors change in U.S. adults after the COVID-19 pandemic? What is the main finding?

pmc-13005364.title: The impact of loneliness on balance learning ability in aging patients with Parkinson’s disease
pmc-13005364.creator: Seyede Zohreh Jazaeri, Mohammad Taghi Joghataei, Akram Jamali, Ghorban Taghizadeh
pmc-13005364.description: ObjectiveLoneliness is highly prevalent among patients with Parkinson’s disease (PwPD) and, through complex body-brain interactions, increases their vulnerability to health issues, including balance impairments. Despite extensive evidence linking loneliness to cognitive-motor dysfunctions, the direct impact of loneliness on motor learning, particularly dynamic balance learning, has not been comprehensively examined.

pmc-13365864.title: Androgen rapidly activates phosphorylation signaling pathways in Sertoli cells
pmc-13365864.creator: Rui Sun, Ye Du, Lian Gao, Zhu Wang, Hui Liang, Ying Zhang, Qiong Deng

pmc-13595238.title: Anatomical and physiological trade-offs underlying the leaf economics spectrum in tropical Andean montane forests
pmc-13595238.creator: Dennis Castillo-Figueroa, Juan M Posada
pmc-13595238.description: Background and aimsThe leaf economic spectrum (LES) offers a comprehensive framework that elucidates the global covariation of leaf functional traits based on an investment and return analysis in leaf tissues, and reflects resource-acquisitive and resource-conservative plant strategies. Yet, this framework has focused on whole-leaf morphological, chemical and physiological traits, offering little insight about the role of the underlying anatomy.
